verdict.rationale: Dialpad's docs confirm that call and voicemail recordings exist and can be retrieved later through a documented download guide. Recording management is also documented: recordings can be removed from specific calls or purged when contacts are anonymized. Nothing in the evidence addresses consent handling such as recording announcements, opt-in/opt-out, or jurisdiction-specific (e.g., two-party consent) rules, and no in-app search for finding recordings is documented. Missing for 10: jurisdiction-aware recording consent controls, consent announcements/opt-out, documented recording search/browse for support leaders, independent or hands-on corroboration.
